title: Pan-Seared Squid with Mushroom and Chestnut
description: A delicious and savory dish featuring pan-seared squid, sautéed mushrooms and chestnuts, and a hint of salt and pepper.

ingredients.name: Kissed
ingredients.notes: Olive oil with garlic and herbs

instructions: Rinse the squid and cut it into bite-sized pieces.
Heat the kissed oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the mushrooms and chestnuts to the pan and cook until they start to brown.
Add the squid to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately and garnish with fresh herbs if desired.
